purpose: Hybrid personalization matrix for creatine quiz results. Scoring selects profile diagnosis, research angles, trust barriers, and habit strategy before AI writes the final user-facing report.

dimensions.moveDemand: How much the user's body needs repeated physical output.
dimensions.strengthDemand: How much the routine depends on force production and progressive overload.
dimensions.repeatEffort: How often the user needs to go again after a burst, set, hill, rally, or interval.
dimensions.stopStartDemand: How much the user's sport depends on quick starts, brakes, turns, carries, stations, or repeated short hard efforts.
dimensions.cognitiveLoad: How much the result should discuss workday focus, mental fatigue, and brain-energy context.
dimensions.recoveryPressure: How much the user needs consistency between sessions.
dimensions.trustBarrier: How much reassurance is needed before benefits matter.
dimensions.habitFriction: How likely the user is to fail because the routine is inconvenient.
dimensions.educationNeed: How much basic explanation is needed.
dimensions.optimizationNeed: How much the user needs advanced tuning rather than basic education.
dimensions.womenContext: Whether women-specific research framing should be included.

profileRules.label: The Stop-Start Athlete
profileRules.description: Padel, tennis, futsal, HIIT, or Hyrox-style routines where repeated short hard efforts matter.

profileRules.label: The Workday Runner
profileRules.description: High repeated physical effort plus meaningful workday cognitive demand.

profileRules.label: The Active Mover
profileRules.description: Several movement demands, usually sport plus training frequency.

profileRules.label: The Strength Builder
profileRules.description: Strength or gym context with enough frequency to make recovery relevant.

profileRules.label: The Curious Beginner
profileRules.description: The person needs confidence and clarity before benefits matter.

profileRules.label: The Habit Builder
profileRules.description: The main barrier is making creatine easy enough to repeat.

profileRules.label: The Long-Game Mover
profileRules.description: Active-aging, strength maintenance, and movement consistency are central.

claimGuardrails: Do not claim creatine treats, cures, prevents, or heals any disease.
Do not claim guaranteed results or instant transformation.
Do not claim fat loss, testosterone increase, hair growth, or hair-loss prevention.
Do not say BPOM registered or Halal certified unless approved assets/status are provided.
For kidney, heart, pregnancy, medication, or medical concerns, recommend consulting a qualified clinician.
Use may support, can help support, is relevant for, or has been studied for. Avoid overclaiming.
